_about: Mission control's hints. Shown in the station after Robbies keep failing the same way in a room. Keys: <room>/<cause>, then general ones. 'after' = consecutive Robbies lost to that cause before the hint appears. Hints nudge; they never give the answer.
start: Mission control: Robbie {n} is ready with a one-rule program. Press LAUNCH and watch what it does.
first_loss: Mission control: Drag along the timeline under the monitor. The panel below it says which rule Robbie was following, and why. Change a rule, then launch the next Robbie.

dark/wall.text: The beacon tells Robbie where the exit is, not how to get there. In a cave, something that keeps in touch with the rock might go further.

dark/energy.text: That Robbie took the long way round. In this cave, left and right are not the same.

jellyfish/jellyfish.text: Watch what the jellyfish do when Robbie's lamp touches them. What if Robbie stopped shining at them?
In the dark, Robbie can still see a jellyfish's own glow. Keeping a little distance might be enough.

jellyfish/wall.text: Backing away from one thing can mean backing into another.

nursery/jellyfish.text: In a tunnel this narrow, the dark won't keep them out of Robbie's way. Something has to clear the path.
Robbie carries a laser. It fires at whatever Robbie senses close by, and every shot costs energy.

nursery/wall.text: The beacon is on the far side of a winding tunnel. The trick from the first room still works here.

nursery/energy.text: Shots and detours both cost energy. That Robbie spent it before the end of the tunnel.

valve/valve.text: The valve has a rhythm. Robbie can tell whether it is shut, as long as the valve is ahead of it.

valve/lurker.text: Something in the rock struck that Robbie. Lurkers are camouflaged: Robbie can't sense one until it wakes and its eyes glow, a moment before it strikes.
The moment a lurker's eyes glow, Robbie can sense it. Keeping a distance from what Robbie senses might be enough, and a lurker that has just struck needs a while to recover.

valve/energy.text: Waiting costs energy too. A Robbie that never moves on runs dry.

listeners/eel.text: The eels don't hunt by sight. Watch what Robbie is doing at the moment one turns on it.
A Robbie that holds still is just another rock to them.

listeners/wall.text: Backing away is still swimming, and swimming is noise.

listeners/energy.text: Waiting costs energy too. Hold still only while one is close.

stuck.text: Every rule costs CPU, but a second rule can catch what the first one misses. Rules are read from the top: the first one that applies wins.
